title: feat: Collapsible activity
body:
> Fixes #

## Changelog Entry

- Added collapsible activity and activity with abstract handling, in PR [#5506](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/5506), by [@OEvgeny](https://github.com/OEvgeny)

## Description

This pull request introduces collapsible activity along with abstract rendering in activity.
  
This is the first step to CoT like UX.

## Design

This feature is of moderate complexity, requiring:

- Updates to the activity rendering engine to preserve the DOM state for each activity.
- Refactoring core rendering logic to support the dynamic activity content.
- Ensuring all changes remain compatible with existing extensibility points and theming, and are fully accessible.

## Specific Changes

- Refactored `StackedLayout` activity renderer to support collapsible sections
- Updated styles and layouts to account for the new abstract/collapsible rendering
- Updated Fluent styles to match updated activity layout
- Updated test snapshots and added tests for collapsible
- Reworked decorator middleware stack to allow injecting request
- Exposed utilities for injecting the specific type of request
- Added `composePipeline` utility as a short term solution for stabilizing rendering tree
- Fixed /decorator export not being fully passed-through in bundle
- Migrated `StackedLayout` to CSS modules
- Added `CodeBlockContent` for rendering code block in attachments or collapsible activity areas
- Added `CollapsibleContent` for rendering collapsible activities
- Added `chevron` icon
- Modified `LinkDefinitions` to use the new chevron icon and removed the old one
- Activity middleware now is aware about abstract and doesn't treat an activity having only abstract as empty
- Added custom properties for activity border and transition
- Exposed `BorderFlair` and `BorderLoader` via `component/decorator`
- Made `BorderFlair` and `BorderLoader` to produce stable render tree
- Fixed error while bundling CodeBlock type definitions
- Updated core activity to handle abstract
- Made Fluent `ActivityLoade` to produce stable render tree
- Fixed missing attachment-bubble setting in Fluent theme
- Reworked Fluent decorator approach with the above changes
- Updated classes where necessary to remove `webchat__` prefix

## -

-  [x] I have added tests and executed them locally
-  [x] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md`
-  [x] ~I have updated documentation~

## Review Checklist

> This section is for contributors to review your work.

-  [x] Accessibility reviewed (tab order, content readability, alt text, color contrast)
-  [x] Browser and platform compatibilities reviewed
-  [x] CSS styles reviewed (minimal rules, no `z-index`)
-  [x] Documents reviewed (docs, samples, live demo)
-  [x] Internationalization reviewed (strings, unit formatting)
-  [x] `package.json` and `package-lock.json` reviewed
-  [x] Security reviewed (no data URIs, check for nonce leak)
-  [x] Tests reviewed (coverage, legitimacy)
